users.description: List of system users to create with SSH access

sudo.description: Sudo privileges as list of rules (empty list = no sudo)

ssh_keys.description: List of SSH public keys to authorize

package_upgrade.description: Whether to run apt-get upgrade on first boot

package_reboot_if_required.description: Whether to reboot automatically if kernel or critical packages are updated

preserve_hostname.description: Preserve existing hostname instead of using metadata-supplied name

hostname.description: System hostname to set on first boot

domain.description: DNS domain to append to hostname for FQDN (optional)

ntp_pools.description: List of NTP server pools for time synchronization

packages.description: List of additional packages to install

runcmd.description: List of shell commands to run during first boot

keyboard_variant.description: Keyboard variant (e.g., 'nodeadkeys'); leave empty for default

ssh_pwauth.description: Enable password authentication for SSH (disabled by default for security)

ssh_deletekeys.description: Delete SSH host keys on first boot to prevent conflicts when images are reused

ssh_genkeytypes.description: Key types to generate for SSH host keys

distro.description: Distribution name (used by cloud-init to select appropriate paths and services)
